**Step 2 — Vessel:** A square plate, approximately 24 cm across. Using an equivalent circular diameter of about 27 cm gives an area of **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** One pear and whole almonds. No visible oil, dressing, or sauce.

| Almonds | 22% | 126 cm² | 0.8 cm | 101 ml | 0.55 g/ml | 55 g | 579 | 318 kcal |

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** About **222 g and 413 kcal** is plausible for a medium pear and roughly 40–45 almonds. The almonds contribute most of the energy.
